85:1.text: By the sky containing great stars

85:3.text: the witness and what is witnessed,

85:4.text: were the companions of the trench

85:6.text: When they were sitting near it.

85:7.text: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.

85:8.text: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

85:9.text: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.

85:10.text: the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

85:11.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

85:13.text: Indeed, it is He who originates

85:14.text: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

85:17.text: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

85:19.text: But they who disbelieve are in

85:20.text: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.

85:21.text: But this is an honored Qur’ān
